_comment: Artifact catalog. Each entry maps a logical artifact to (a) path patterns relative to the drive root, (b) the parser that handles it, and (c) a tier. The engine parses tier<=selected. 'default' runs by default; add artifacts to a run with -Artifacts <name,name> or by moving them to the 'default' tier. To ADD a new artifact: copy a block, set paths + parser + tier. Parsers are defined in config/parsers.json. {user} expands to each user profile found under Users\.

MFT.purpose: File existence, paths, $SI/$FN timestamps (incl. deleted files).

Amcache.purpose: Program presence with SHA1 of the first ~31MB only. Presence, NOT execution proof; large files never hash-match.

Prefetch.purpose: Execution evidence: run counts, run times. Disabled by default on Windows Server - absence there is expected.

Registry.purpose: Run keys, services, autoruns via RECmd Kroll batch (system hives only; avoids stale Windows.old/RegBack epochs).

ScheduledTasks.purpose: Raw scheduled-task XML (no EZ parser; copied for review).

SRUM.purpose: Per-app network bytes + execution (needs SOFTWARE hive).

LNK.purpose: Shortcut files: target volume serial/type (USB source).

LogFile.purpose: NTFS transaction log (note: limited EZ support; copied/parsed best-effort).
